description: Somos a Estrellar, uma equipe apaixonada por ciência, tecnologia e exploração espacial. Inspirados pelo desafio da NASA “Be An Earth System Trend Detective!”, criamos o Interplanetarium, uma plataforma interativa para explorar os sistemas da Terra e suas mudanças ambientais. Dentro dela, desenvolvemos o Planetares, um jogo educativo que transforma ciência em diversão. Nossa missão é conectar pessoas, tecnologia e conhecimento para compreender melhor nosso planeta.
summary: Interplanetarium is an educational project developed by the Estrellar team to help the public explore space and understand Earth’s interconnected systems. The project brings together interactive experiences, including an Earth Explorer, a Data Lab, a Trend Detective activity, and the educational game Planetares. Visitors can investigate topics related to the atmosphere, hydrosphere, biosphere, geosphere, and cryosphere through exploration and learning activities. By connecting scientific information with accessible, interactive experiences, Interplanetarium aims to encourage curiosity and make Earth science more engaging. Sources are identified alongside scientific data so visitors can consult the original information.
details:
Interplanetarium is an educational website created by the Estrellar team. It brings together an Earth Explorer, a Data Lab, a Trend Detective activity, and Planetares, an educational game. The project is designed to help visitors explore Earth’s systems, investigate environmental information, and learn through interactive experiences.

The creative approach is to combine scientific exploration with accessible activities, encouraging visitors to ask questions, examine patterns, and learn at their own pace. The intended impact is to make Earth science more engaging and approachable, especially for people who are new to the subject.

The website was developed with Lovable. AI tools assisted the team with drafting and reviewing text, prompts, ideas, and other project-development tasks. Add the programming languages, frameworks, libraries, APIs, and data sources actually used before submitting. Scientific data sources should be identified in the project and checked against their original providers.

Note: English is included via a flag icon located in the upper right corner.
